phases.result: Real Q2 entropy-only chunks: ABBA on PS5, all decoded bytes exact; 4.2553% fewer bytes, unchanged requests, approximately 97% greater total delivery latency. No CPU adoption. This is not a hardware or general LZ Kraken decoder.

phases.work: On PS5 compare original read versus read+completion batches at 1/2/4 requests, and raw versus Kraken read+decode+delivery, with identical decoded bytes and explicit cache state.
Integrate promising candidates behind a reversible selector, run matched native model requests, and deploy only a repeatable end-to-end improvement with ordinary completion and exact source delivery.
